definitions.explanation: The process of reducing temperature, often used in technical or industrial contexts.

examples.japanese: {冷却|れいきゃく}{装置|そうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00378_tsukau⟧。
{冷却|れいきゃく}{期間|きかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：00482_oku⟧。

notes:
{冷却|れいきゃく} refers to the process of cooling, often in technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷却|れいきゃく}する (to cool)
- {冷却|れいきゃく}{装置|そうち} (cooling system)
- {冷却|れいきゃく}{水|すい} (coolant water)
- {冷却|れいきゃく}{期間|きかん} (cooling-off period)

RELATED TERMS:
- {加熱|かねつ}: heating (opposite)
- ⟦{冷|ひ}やす→冷やす：01234_hiyasu⟧: to cool (everyday)
- {冷凍|れいとう}: freezing
- {冷蔵|れいぞう}: refrigeration
